data_objects.name: offense_age_records
data_objects.meaning: Year- and age-specific offense records carrying an offense label, an aggregated count measure, offense category and type, and boolean legal-status flags.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar year associated with the offense record.

variables.name: Offense
variables.meaning: Name of the offense represented by the record.

variables.name: Age
variables.meaning: Age associated with the offense record.

variables.name: Count
variables.meaning: Aggregated count measure for the year, offense, and age combination; the counted entity is not stated.

variables.name: Disqualifying_Offense
variables.meaning: Boolean indicator labeling whether the offense is disqualifying under an unspecified rule or policy.

variables.name: Offense_Type
variables.meaning: Legal type or severity category assigned to the offense.

variables.name: Expungible
variables.meaning: Boolean indicator labeling whether the offense is expungible under an unspecified rule or policy.

structure.description: Each row describes a calendar-year, offense, and age combination with an associated count and offense-level classifications.
Category, Disqualifying_Offense, Offense_Type, and Expungible classify the named offense, while Count is the numeric measure for the row's year and age context.

uncertainties: The jurisdiction, source population, counted entity, and legal definitions governing the boolean flags are not specified.
Date is formatted as a year even though its column name does not state the granularity.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels, boolean encodings, and values visible in train.csv.
